audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and First item were given to Locke and 2+ items was marked 'Skill', while the content whys[] for those exact stages say 'Level 6 is even', 'First item stays even', and 'Two-plus items are Dr. Mundo's'.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Skill through First item and Dr. Mundo at 2+ items, the whys agree with it, and the win rate is 54.08% over 858 games — a lane Mundo edges, not one Locke owns at 6.
audit.corrected: Skill for Level 1 through First item, Dr. Mundo at 2+ items — ratings 5/5/5/5/5/5/7.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] carried no cooldown numbers at all, and the packet's own defect list says there is NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in this matchup.
audit.why: Infected Bonesaw is 4s flat against Locke's Q at 10/9/8/7/6s, Ashen Pursuit is a flat 10s, Soul Ignition 18/17/16/15/14s, and his R is 120/100/80s. Those numbers turn vague advice into a schedule.
audit.corrected: Each spike now names the cooldown it is keyed to, and the post-Ashen-Pursuit 10 seconds is stated as the commit window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said 'Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.' A don't tells you not to burn your 'gap-closer' — Dr. Mundo has none.
audit.why: Soul Ignition damages Locke during the effect and heals a portion back AT THE END of the duration; Grievous Wounds applied before that refund lands cuts it, so anti-heal is not optional. Blunt Force Trauma is a targeted slam with an auto-attack reset — no mobility anywhere in Mundo's kit. Silver Stake (P) adds on-hit magic damage that scales with your MISSING health, so sitting low compounds against you, and Ashen Pursuit opens with an auto-reset whose wind-up is the tell.
audit.corrected: Call for Grievous Wounds before Soul Ignition's end-of-duration refund; replace the gap-closer line with 'trade while Ashen Pursuit is up'; note the passive punishes low HP.

audit.why: That is Dr. Mundo's real R name; the possessive apostrophe caused the near-miss. False positive.

edits.before: Purgatory changes the rules: fights now end at HIS floor — disengage above ~15% or leave the totem zone entirely.
edits.after: Purgatory (120s) ends fights at his floor, but Maximum Dosage heals percent missing HP — press R and the execute misses.

edits.before: Lich Bane spike — his blink-bite now genuinely one-shots marked squishies. Respect the all-in until his E is down.
edits.after: His first-item burst still bites, but your regen ramps to match — hold the stage even and wait out Ashen Pursuit's 10s.

edits.before: Level 1 he’s a 125-range mana champ throwing nails — step off the recast lines and take what the range difference offers.
edits.after: Level 1 his Q costs 70 mana on a 10s cooldown — step off the recast lines and make him spend the bar on nothing at all.

edits.before: The percent-HP cleaver poke war settles into its rhythm — his chip against your chip, with regen quietly on your side.
edits.after: Infected Bonesaw is a 4s cooldown against his Q's 10s at rank 1 — you land more than two pokes for each one of his.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage answers his ult threat — cast it before his commitment, not after, and the stage stays even.
edits.after: Maximum Dosage (120s) answers his execute — cast it before he commits, not after, to stay above the floor.

edits.before: His AP burst still bites while your regen ramps — one more even stage before the math tips.
edits.after: Ashen Pursuit is a flat 10s blink and auto-reset — the 10s after he spends it is your window.

edits.before: Locke wastes Ritual Nails — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Break off above his execute floor — Maximum Dosage buys that.

edits.before: Burn your gap-closer while his E is up
edits.after: Trade while Ashen Pursuit is still up

edits.before: E is his engage AND escape — a spent blink is the lane’s biggest cooldown; don’t waste yours before it.
edits.after: Ashen Pursuit is his engage AND escape on a flat 10s — those ten seconds are the only safe window in the lane.

edits.before: Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip (his damage is AP). A stopwatch/Zhonya’s-class answer beats Purgatory outright: untargetable at the floor = execute denied. Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.
edits.after: Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip (his damage is AP). A stopwatch/Zhonya’s-class answer beats Purgatory outright: untargetable at the floor = execute denied. Bring Grievous Wounds — Soul Ignition refunds its self-damage at the end, so apply it first.

edits.before: - Locke Ritual Nails (Marks): matchup-defining — The nail marks are his whole engine — without 2-3 stacks on you his blink-in barely dents; sidestep the recasts and punish the ten seconds of nothing. Track it before every step-up. - Locke E (Ashen Pursuit): his ONLY mobility, resets on takedowns — the post-E window is the lane. - Locke R (Purgatory): never fight at sliver HP inside the zone.
edits.after: - Locke's nail marks (Q, 10s at rank 1 down to 6s): his whole engine — without stacks on you his blink-in barely dents, so sidestep the recasts and step up in that gap. - Ashen Pursuit (E, flat 10s): his ONLY mobility and an auto-reset — the wind-up is the tell, and the ten seconds after are the lane. - Soul Ignition (W, 18s at rank 1): it refunds his self-damage at the END — land Grievous Wounds before then. - Purgatory (R, 120s at rank 1): never sit at sliver HP inside it.

edits.before: Post-6: the totem rewrites fight math — win exchanges early, disengage above the floor, and punish the ten seconds after every spent E.
edits.after: Post-6: Purgatory rewrites fight math, but Maximum Dosage heals percent MISSING health — pressing R at the floor is exactly what denies the execute. Commit in the 10s after every spent Ashen Pursuit.

edits.before: Levels 1-3: he pays for every CS at 125 range — tax him, but step off the Q recast lines; the mark stacks are the only currency he trades in.
edits.after: Levels 1-3: his Q costs 70 mana on a 10s cooldown while Infected Bonesaw costs nothing on 4s — tax him, step off the recast lines, and never sit low, because his passive scales with your missing health.

notes: Level chart flipped to the packet and to its own whys: Skill through First item, Dr. Mundo at 2+ items. The full-layer why-text for Level 6 and First item had been arguing for Locke (Purgatory floor, a 'Lich Bane spike') against every other source, so I rewrote both. Corrected the itemization line that called anti-heal optional — Soul Ignition heals back a portion of its self-damage at the END of the duration, so Grievous Wounds applied before that tick is decisive. Removed the 'burn your gap-closer' don't: Dr. Mundo has no dash or blink of any kind. QUESTION LOGGED, text left alone: this page calls Locke's Q 'Ritual Nails' but Riot's own description for that slot says 'Soul Nails', and the kit file gives no ability names for Locke — I could not verify which is the display name, so I did not rename it. UNVERIFIED: the 'Lich Bane spike' and the '125 range' claim; the kit lists Q 950 / E 425 / W 250 range and no auto range, and I would not guess an item build for a champion the kits do not describe. The W trueDamage derived flag contradicts Riot's description, which mentions no true damage — I did not assert it.
